title: Custom Football Above Yard Lines Perspective Comforter
description:
Transform your space with the Jeminise sports bedding set, offering a cozy and stylish design perfect for football fans, players, and coaches. Whether you choose the lightweight duvet cover or the cozy all-in-one comforter, this bedding brings the spirit of the game into your bedroom, kids' room, or guestroom. It makes a thoughtful, personalized gift for holidays, birthdays, and special celebrations.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Fully customizable with 2 text inputs for a name and number to make your sports bedding unique.
  • Comfort & Warmth: Crafted from 100% brushed polyester fabric, offering a soft, lightweight, and highly durable feel for all-season comfort.
  • Duvet Cover & Comforter Options: Choose between a lightweight duvet cover designed for an insert, or a thicker comforter filled with clean microfiber to prevent clumping.
  • Available Sizes: Perfectly sized for various beds, including Twin (68x88 in), Full (78x88 in), Queen (88x88 in), and King (104x88 in).
  • Included Components: Each set includes 1 duvet cover or comforter, with options to add matching pillowcases or a flat sheet.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water on a gentle cycle; tumble dry on low heat or air dry without heat.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester
Fill Material Microfiber
Selected Design Golden Football
Style Contemporary
Theme Football
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine wash with cold water, Tumble dry on low heat, Iron on low/medium heat
